items.title: Add earlier main-sync readiness reporting
items.context: Expose branch-behind-main readiness before late DONE closure, preferably through an existing read-only lifecycle/session surface. It must point to the existing done_prepare/main-sync path and must not perform a merge by itself.
items.userSees: Before REVIEW or late TEST, Lattice tells the user when the story branch is behind main and what command should refresh it.
excludes: Do not change story_advance DONE merge authority.
Do not add a new automatic merge path outside done_prepare/story_advance.
Do not claim Authority or production proof.

happy.desc: A story branch behind main gets a visible pre-DONE readiness hint with the behind count and existing sync command.

edge.desc: A story branch already synced with main does not show a false warning.

adversarial.desc: The new readiness signal is read-only and does not mutate phase, merge main, or bypass DONE closure gates.

items.title: Add regression coverage for the readiness signal
items.context: Add a focused smoke test that creates fixture branches and proves the read-only readiness behavior for behind-main, synced, and no-mutation cases.
items.userSees: lattice validate --focus=fast can prove the main-sync readiness behavior without running the whole suite.
excludes: Do not add a slow full-suite-only regression.
Do not require network or remote git access.

happy.desc: The focused smoke passes and is wired into lattice validate --focus=fast.

edge.desc: Full validate still includes the smoke through configured validate.commands.

adversarial.desc: The smoke proves the readiness path is read-only by checking no merge/phase mutation occurs.

items.title: Record baseline result for item 4
items.context: Add a derived baseline result artifact for baseline item 4 without modifying the immutable baseline v1 JSON.
items.userSees: The baseline comparison has a durable item 4 result entry for future tasks.
excludes: Do not collapse this with delivery-check freshness or DONE summary freshness.

happy.desc: The result artifact references baseline item 4, this story id, and the readiness behavior.

edge.desc: The immutable baseline file remains unchanged.

adversarial.desc: The result artifact states this is local lifecycle readiness coverage only, not Authority or production proof.
